sources.title: CIA World Factbook · archived country profile

recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Dependency. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
capital: Episkopi Cantonment (base administrative center for Akrotiri and Dhekelia)
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); Administrator Air Vice-Marshal Peter J.M. SQUIRES (since 1 September 2022); note - administrator reports to the British Ministry of Defense and is also Commander, British Forces Cyprus (BFC); the chief officer, an appointed civilian, is responsible for the day-to-day running of the civil government of the Sovereign Base Areas
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
